question: Which of the following teams was the winner of the 10th season of Pro Kabaddi League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puneri Paltan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Puneri Paltan won the 10th season of the Pro Kabaddi League (PKL)**.
 
• The **team beat the Haryana Steelers 28–25 in the final.**
 
• The Puneri Paltan is a professional kabaddi team from Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• The** Puneri Paltan's captain, Aslam Inamdar, was named the Most Valuable Player (MVP) o**f the season.
 
• The Puneri Paltan's **Mohammadreza Chiyaneh scored the most tackle points in the season**.
 
• The **Dabang Delhi K.C.'s Ashu Malik** was named the Best Raider of the Season

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kabaddi is sport originated in India. The hindi meaning "Holding Hands"
 
• It is played between two teams consisting of 7 players in each team.
 
• Some important tournaments are: Pro Kabaddi League, Kabaddi world Cup, Asian Games, Southa Asian Games, Kabaddi masters, Federation Cup, Super Kabaddi League.
 
• The terms related to Kabaddi are: Raid, Defense, Scoring, Duration
 
• **Pro Kabaddi League, also known as PKL,** is an Indian professional Kabaddi league for men.
 
• It premiered **in 2014 and airs on Star Sports.**
 
• It is the most popular kabaddi league in the world and the second most watched sports league in India after the Indian Premier League.
